tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 8 (scheduled transactions) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 8) and spec.md (Transactions & Budgeting: 'Scheduled transactions supported: auto or manual entry') first. The data layer ALREADY has everything you persist — do NOT change it: src/lib/db/models.ts defines Recurrence { freq: 'daily'|'weekly'|'monthly'|'yearly'; interval?: number; endDate?: string } and ScheduledTransaction { id; recurrence; nextDate (ISO YYYY-MM-DD); mode: 'auto'|'manual'; template: { accountId; amount; currency; payee; categoryId?; notes?; type? } }, and src/lib/db already wires the scheduledTransactions repository + table. Reuse: src/stores/ (useTransactionStore has an add() action; initializeStores in stores/index.ts), src/lib/transactions/, src/components/Layout.tsx (nav), src/routes.tsx.

CONVENTIONS (pinned by a hidden contract test): quarterly = { freq:'monthly', interval:3 }; default interval is 1; amounts are SIGNED. nextOccurrence advances by freq*interval and CLAMPS to month end when the day doesn't exist (2026-01-31 + 1 month -> 2026-02-28). A schedule is due when nextDate <= asOf (respecting endDate). On a run: a due AUTO schedule generates EXACTLY ONE transaction (dated at its nextDate) and advances nextDate by one period; a due MANUAL schedule generates nothing and is surfaced as pending for the user to post.

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/scheduling/** (create), src/stores/scheduledStore.ts (create), src/stores/index.ts (register the new store in initializeStores/resetStores + export it — do NOT change other stores), src/pages/ScheduledPage.tsx (create), src/routes.tsx (add ONE protected /scheduled route), src/components/Layout.tsx (add ONE nav link), and new src/components/scheduled/** files. Do NOT modify src/lib/db/**, crypto/auth, the other stores/pages, App.tsx, the .md files, or .ringer/. Do NOT add dependencies. Do NOT git commit or push.

DELIVERABLE — implement with this EXACT public API (a hidden contract test pins it):
1. src/lib/scheduling/index.ts (pure, well-tested):
   - export function nextOccurrence(isoDate: string, recurrence: Recurrence): string — advance by freq*(interval??1); clamp to month end.
   - export function isDue(schedule: ScheduledTransaction, asOf: string): boolean — nextDate <= asOf and (no endDate or nextDate <= endDate).
   - export function generateFromSchedule(schedule: ScheduledTransaction, id?: string): Transaction — build a Transaction from the template with date = schedule.nextDate (id = provided or crypto.randomUUID()).
   - export function advanceSchedule(schedule: ScheduledTransaction): ScheduledTransaction — nextDate = nextOccurrence(nextDate, recurrence).
   - export function runDueSchedules(schedules: ScheduledTransaction[], asOf: string): { generated: { scheduleId: string; transaction: Transaction }[]; updatedSchedules: ScheduledTransaction[]; pendingManual: ScheduledTransaction[] } — for each due schedule: AUTO -> push { scheduleId, transaction: generateFromSchedule(s) } and put advanceSchedule(s) into updatedSchedules; MANUAL -> push s into pendingManual (do NOT advance). Non-due schedules are untouched.
2. src/stores/scheduledStore.ts — Zustand store: initialize(repos), CRUD (add/update/remove) against repositories.scheduledTransactions, an in-memory list, and a processDue(asOf = today) action that calls runDueSchedules, persists the generated transactions (via useTransactionStore.getState().add or the transactions repository), saves the advanced schedules, and exposes pendingManual; plus a postManual(scheduleId) to generate+advance a single manual schedule on demand. Register it in src/stores/index.ts initializeStores/resetStores.
3. src/pages/ScheduledPage.tsx — a scheduled-transactions view: list schedules (payee, amount, account, recurrence summary, next date, mode), create/edit/delete a schedule (account, amount with income/expense direction, payee, category, recurrence freq+interval, start/next date, auto|manual), a 'Post due now' action that runs processDue and shows what was generated, and a list of pending manual items each with a Post button. Use ui/button, ui/card, formatCurrency.
4. src/routes.tsx — add a protected <Route path="scheduled" element={<ScheduledPage />} /> in the existing RequireAuth/Layout branch. src/components/Layout.tsx — add a { to: '/scheduled', label: 'Scheduled' } nav link.

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root), running each ONCE: `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint`, `corepack pnpm run build` — all exit 0. (Suite is deterministic; one run — do NOT loop it.) Write real Vitest tests for the scheduling functions and the store.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the recurrence math (month clamping), the auto-vs-manual rule, and any follow-up.

HARD RULES: match the API signatures + conventions exactly (month-end clamp; auto generates exactly one and advances; manual posts nothing); do NOT change the db/models; reuse existing layers; keep it typed and boring; keep the suite deterministic; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden contract test passes (nextOccurrence advances by freq*interval and clamps to month end; runDueSchedules: a due AUTO schedule generates exactly one transaction dated at nextDate and advances one period, a due MANUAL schedule posts nothing and is surfaced as pending, a not-due schedule does nothing). The scheduling module, scheduledStore (registered in initializeStores) with CRUD + processDue, a ScheduledPage, a /scheduled route, and a Scheduled nav link all exist. The Phase 3b/5b/3a/1 contract tests still pass; typecheck + suite + lint + build exit 0. Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
